title: Almost-sure rounded cut value for the five-cycle
statement: Let $g=(g_0,dots,g_4)$ be sampled from the product of five standard Gaussian probability measures on $\mathbb R$. With probability one, rounding the five-cycle SDP vectors by the signs of their inner products with $g$ produces a cut of value $4/5$.
hypotheses_covered: $g$ is distributed according to the product standard Gaussian measure on $\mathbb R^5$
